Browser dependency provenance

js-yaml-4.1.0.min.js is the unmodified browser build from the published
js-yaml@4.1.0 npm package. It is vendored so generated public pages can parse
YAML without a CDN or network request.

Upstream: https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml
Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/js-yaml/v/4.1.0
License: MIT, retained in js-yaml-4.1.0.LICENSE.txt
SHA-256: 45dc3dd03dc07a06705a2c2989b8c7f709013f04bd5386e3279d4e447f07ebd7

../config-diff-browser.js holds lines 6 to 128 of lib/config-diff.mjs from
https://github.com/confighub/cub-workshop at commit
55c51a67db2c9517e21bd3286207e28ff1a78ed3, unmodified, between two markers. It
is the comparison that `cub config diff` runs. It is vendored so a chart page
computes a diff in the reader's browser, on demand, with the same code.

Record: config-diff.source.json
License: MIT
Core SHA-256: 9265ab17a157ef8b00171384f24ec58ae939aac210e5a1a4208a432dae4578b1
Gate: npm run site:config-diff:verify
